idea-plugin.name: Petrichor
idea-plugin.description:
Petrichor is a color scheme inspired by the colors of rainy days; it's meant to be cozy, soft, and practical.

This is a JetBrains port of the original Petrichor color scheme by Monocled.

  • Cozy, soft, low-saturation colors with good contrast.
  • Comments are deliberately highlighted.
  • Syntax token mapping inspired by the Catppuccin theme.

Four variants are included:

  • Petrichor Dark
  • Petrichor Light
  • Petrichor Dark (Islands)
  • Petrichor Light (Islands)
